name: 0.5 - Acts I-IV and Interludes 1-3
note: The guide pack for the Campaign Helper (2.77.0). Hand-written: each step's 'do', the tips, the rewards and the vendor searches. Zones the game adds are learned from players' logs (Community data sharing) and added by tools/build_guide.py. 'side': a detour off the story path (left out of the Speedrun route). 'speed' (2.89.0): the Speedrun guide - skip: left out; do: its own instruction. A reward with "speed": true is still taken in a speedrun (the rest aren't asked about). 'optional': shown only with Show optional zones. 'proof': zones whose entry proves a reward was taken.

acts.name: Act I

steps.do: Town - talk to Renly and Una
Kill Beira of the Rotten Pack

speed.do: Kill Beira (+10% cold res), then head to the Grelwood. Skip the Mud Burrow.

steps.do: Light the Witch Hut cauldron (free flask), then on to the Red Vale

speed.do: Grab the waypoints and skip the Witch Hut. Come back later to place the Runed Spikes at the Tree of Souls.

steps.do: Activate the obelisks, kill the Rust King

speed.do: Run through to the Cemetery. Skip Ervig.

steps.do: Open the Tomb and the Mausoleum

speed.do: Open the Tomb and the Mausoleum. Skip the side ruins.

steps.do: Kill Draven, then Lachlann in the Cemetery

speed.do: Kill Draven, then Lachlann in the Cemetery. Skip the hidden cache.
Kill the Crowbell (+2 points). Grab the Freythorn and Ogham Farmlands waypoints.

steps.do: Kill the King in the Mists

speed.do: Light the 3 small altars, kill the King in the Mists (+30 spirit). Skip the Ominous Altars.
Grab Una's Lute (+2 points) and keep going.

steps.do: Get Renly's Smithing Tools, kill the Executioner

speed.do: Kill the Executioner. Get the Smithing Tools only on your first character this league.

acts.tip: Check the vendors for 15% movement speed boots from about level 16.

acts.name: Act II

speed.do: Skip the packs and go straight to Rathbreaker.
Run up to the Halani Gates. Skip Balbala - you get a better Barya in Deshar.
Do it later, at about level 28, with the Barya from Deshar, right before The Dreadnought.

steps.do: Kill Iktab and Ekbab - take the relic

speed.do: Kill hyenas until the Sun Clan Relic drops, then kill Iktab and Ekbab.
Kill snakes until the Kabala Clan Relic drops, then kill Kabala (+2 points).
Kill Azarian, take the Essence of Water. Skip the offering shrine and sarcophagus.

steps.do: Place both relics at the altar
Find the Final Letter, give it to Shambrin

speed.do: Take the Final Letter (+2 points). Kill the Watchful Twins for the level 28 Barya.

steps.do: Pray at the Sisters of Garukhan shrine, kill Tor Gul

speed.do: Kill Jamanra, the Abomination, here at about level 28.

acts.tip: Trial of the Sekhemas gives your first 2 ascendancy points. Look for 20% boots from about level 33.

acts.name: Act III

speed.do: Run to the town. Skip Rootdredge.
Kill Mighty Silverfist (+2 points). Skip the camps.

steps.do: Take the Venom Vial to Servi (a choice you keep)

speed.do: Grab the venom and go back to town for Servi's choice. Skip the side events.

steps.do: On to the Azak Bog and the Wetlands

speed.do: Run through to the Chimeral Wetlands.
You reach it from the Matlan Waterways now. Kill Ignagduk (+30 spirit).
Kill Xyclucian. Skip the camps.

steps.do: Kill Zicoatl, Warden of the Core
On to the Molten Vault and the Apex

speed.do: Run through to the Apex of Filth.
First character this league only: kill Mektul for the Reforging Bench. Skip it on later characters.
Kill the Queen of Filth. Skip the cauldron.

steps.do: Kill Ketzuli, High Priest of the Sun

speed.do: Follow the road to Viper Napuatzi. Kill Vaal Goliaths until the Sacrificial Heart drops.

steps.do: Offer the Sacrificial Heart at the altar

acts.tip: Trial of Chaos gives 2 more ascendancy points.

acts.name: Act IV

speed.do: Run to the Volcanic Warrens. Skip the Primal Arena.
Kill Krutog. Skip the Volcanic Nest.

steps.do: Finish the three trials (a choice each)
Kill the Scourge of the Skies

speed.do: Run to the Singing Caverns. Skip the shark and the crab cave.
Kill Diamora. Skip the Humming Pearl.
Find the way to Solitary Confinement. Do the Goddess of Justice only if the Chapel Key drops on the way.
Follow the path to Journey's End. Skip the side areas.
Skip the bells and go straight to the main objective.
Run straight to the boss.

steps.do: On to the Heart of the Tribe

speed.do: Run to the Heart of the Tribe. Skip the Mad Butcher.

acts.tip: Aim for 25% boots by about level 46.

steps.do: Kill Akthi and Anundr, talk to Risu

speed.do: Kill Akthi and Anundr, talk to Risu. Use the Molten One's Gift (+5% life).

steps.do: Pick a boon at the Seven Pillars

speed.do: Pick a boon at the Seven Pillars (in a niche at the map edge). Do not pick the experience boon.

steps.do: Talk to Elder Madox - a free unique

acts.name: Interlude 3
acts.tip: Then talk to the Hooded One in Kingsmarch for 2 more points.

rewards.what: The Hooded One, after the Interludes
